headline: OpenAI and Oracle announce ChatGPT integrations and a new enterprise distribution route
summary: OpenAI announced an expanded Oracle partnership covering Oracle application integrations with ChatGPT, new Oracle offerings built with OpenAI products, and access through Oracle Marketplace. Oracle AI Workspace is in development to connect Oracle applications and data with ChatGPT; Oracle also announced an SMB Bundle and App Composer. OpenAI says U.S. Oracle customers can purchase its API, Codex and ChatGPT Work through the marketplace using eligible Oracle Universal Credits. These are partner announcements; the release does not establish general availability, comparative prices or measured outcomes.
